# FDG8033

> CONSIDER inheriting from `Collection<T>`, `ReadOnlyCollection<T>`, or `KeyedCollection<TKey,TItem>` when designing new collections.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.3.4 Implementing Custom Collections.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test suggestion
- Status: verified

Not machine-checkable: whether a new collection should inherit from a base collection is a design choice. FDG8037 forbids the non-generic base collections.

## From the book

```csharp
public class OrderCollection : Collection<Order> {
  protected override void InsertItem(int index, Order item) {
    ...
  }
}
```
